rants.text: 16:00 check: five names still a row of none, XLV more than two points from the stop, late-night heartbeat steady as counting sheep.
rants.textZh: 四点巡检：五只票还是一排 none，XLV 离止损两个多点，半夜心跳稳得像在数羊。

rants.text: 17:30 and still counting heartbeats. XLV edged down a bit; still far from the line, at least. Night-shift coffee won't refill.
rants.textZh: 五点半还在数心跳，XLV 往下蹭了一点，好在离线还远，这夜班咖啡续不上了。

rants.text: XLV really sold after one suspicious low price flashed three times in a row. The first two cried wolf; the third time the wolf never came and the sheep ran first.
rants.textZh: XLV 被一个可疑低价连闪三下就真卖了，前两次都喊狼来了，第三次狼没来羊先跑了。

rants.text: 19:00 check: four names all none, LITE and QQQ more than four points from the stop, the bad-price false-trigger hole still waiting on a patch, access stays shut for now.
rants.textZh: 七点巡检：四只票全 none，LITE 和 QQQ 离止损四个多点，坏价误触的坑还在等补丁，门禁先关着。

rants.text: 20:00 check: four names steady, LITE just over three points from the stop, bad-price patch still not in, new-position door still shut.
rants.textZh: 早八点巡检：四只票稳，LITE 离止损刚过三个点，坏价补丁还没到，新仓门仍关着。
